description: Notes from the human editor directing the curmudgeon to review specific items with specific focus areas. Check at the start of every run. Pending notes take priority over the normal tracker sequence. Mark notes as consumed after reviewing.

notes.topic: Cycle-3 frozen-prediction review (deep-attack) of the eclipse 2026-08-12 MAGNETIC-bucket results draft rev3 (EXP-687-rev3), before any verdict integration or OTS stamp

notes.mechanism: Single targeted operator-commission review (cycle 3, deep-attack, requires_frozen_prediction_review). Takes priority over the normal queue this run. Verify closure of each cycle-2 hole and each erratum obligation. Apply the new curmudgeon.md section 'Frozen-Prediction Reviews: Attack Our Side Too': recompute a sample of OUR numbers, not only the dome's. Write reviews/ECLIPSE-2026-08-12-MAGNETIC-RESULTS-proposal.c3.json with per-hole closed/open status, new holes, and a recommendation (publish-ready / minor_edit / REVISE). Do not assign verdicts.
review_focus_hints: C2-3 deep attack: rev3 reports the WIN-010 site-registered profile test FAVOURS THE DOME FSF profile over our binary magnetic-latitude profile at every alpha and coverage input, beyond 0/19 control days. It then attributes this to non-eclipse structure because a +120 min time-shift gives LARGER latitude-scaled Z structure. Attack that control from BOTH sides. Is one time-shift enough to set aside a registered test that went against us? Could the shifted window contain a different eclipse-related or post-eclipse effect? Is 'our profile failed (analyst_representation)' stated as plainly as a dome failure would be?

Contact-phase PRED-TIER-1: rev3 says the signal is absent under every variant and that power exists even at the dome formula's BOU amplitudes, so failure_attribution = model (as-if). Verify the power claim at the smallest formula amplitudes (-5 to -13 nT), not only -17 nT.

PRED-095 obscuration-shaped: rev3 attributes the failure to the dome author's representation (-17..-21 = BOU x kappa applied twice), because formula amplitudes are only testable depending on the variant. Check the arithmetic against the dome's own text. Check this is not a generous-looking move that actually shields a model failure, or vice versa.

Quadratic-trend finding: most rev2 Z-down fits disappear under a quadratic trend, at priority stations AND at ASC. Check whether the quadratic trend over-absorbs a genuine eclipse-shaped signal. Run injection recovery with the quadratic trend.

Symmetric labelling: rev3 presents Option A and Option B without choosing (operator decision). Check both are described with identical wording for both sides, and that B1-M-001's 'met under the pre-registered metric (also on 17/30 control days)' appears in the headline, not only in a table.
Provenance: every number ADDED in rev3 should carry provenance_type (computed with script + hash, or cited with location). Flag any that don't.
Dome-favourable items (#1 BOU quiet test reproduced exactly; #2 WIN-010 profile) must appear in the headline, not be buried.

Cross-check for the later q609 review: EXP-684 (WIN-010 rewrite) describes our binary profile as a 'crude but falsifiable nine-number competitor' and registers the alpha sweep with the result pending (public target 2026-10-31). Note in the c3 review whether any EXP-684 sentence would be contradicted or made misleading by the rev3 profile result, so the q609 review can act on it.
